_comment: What each real-capture clip types into a fresh Notepad, and the screen region recorded (x, y, width, height in physical pixels; Notepad is maximised). Steps are plain typing: whatever appears beyond the typed characters (expansions, tooltips, AI predictions) is the installed driver's own doing. Step kinds: text (delay in ms between keys), key (Enter, Tab...), wait (ms), accept (waits until the driver shows a prediction, leaves it on screen briefly, then asks the driver to insert it).
